item.description: Run in order. Step 3 is manual: sign up in Entra with signupEmail, then set authCode.
item.name: 00 - Authentication Flow

request.description: Disable Follow Redirects. Copy Entra URL from Location header, open in browser, sign up, paste auth code into environment.
Sign up with signupEmail. Copy code from callback into authCode.
Run after browser sign-up. Set authCode from callback URL.

item.description: UI login: validates active user and returns Entra redirect URL (no invitation).
item.name: 01 - UI Login Flow

request.description: POST with active platform user email. Copy data.redirectUrl and open in browser. Callback state is user:{userId}.
Sign in with the same email. Copy code from callback; set loginUserId from state if needed.
Invitation-free callback. state must be user:{platformUserId}.
